jsch generate --schema schema.json --out ./model --package model --type Tree

exec go test -count=1 ./model

-- schema.json --
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "Node": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "value":    {"type": "string"},
        "children": {"type": "array", "items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/Node"}}
      },
      "required": ["value"]
    }
  },
  "properties": {
    "root": {"$ref": "#/$defs/Node"}
  },
  "required": ["root"]
}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/treepkg

go 1.27
-- model/model_test.go --
package model

import (
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"testing"
)

func TestTree_RoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	in := []byte(`{"root":{"children":[{"value":"a"},{"value":"b"}],"value":"root"}}`)
	var tr Tree
	if err := json.Unmarshal(in, &tr); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	if tr.Root.Value != "root" {
		t.Errorf("Root.Value = %q, want root", tr.Root.Value)
	}
	if len(tr.Root.Children) != 2 || tr.Root.Children[0].Value != "a" {
		t.Errorf("Root.Children = %#v", tr.Root.Children)
	}
	out, err := json.Marshal(tr)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Marshal: %v", err)
	}
	if string(out) != `{"root":{"children":[{"value":"a"},{"value":"b"}],"value":"root"}}` {
		t.Errorf("Marshal = %s", out)
	}
}
